title: Release Contrast Workbench and Auto-Fallback Playbook
creator: Aisha Kramer
description: Build a Release Contrast Workbench inside Console that lets engineers inspect behavioral and cost differences between two or more model variants (control, variant, mirrored) for a given route and time window, and orchestrate an automated fallback when a regression is detected. The workbench combines: per-route time-series and histogram deltas, request-level trace-linking to compare paired requests, token-level cost and latency deltas, structured-output diffs (JSON/func-call fields), and a policy editor for automatic fallback/rollback thresholds. This ticket defines scope, success criteria, and a delivery plan. Key constraints: must integrate with existing telemetry pipeline (span and metric schemas), support both hosted and Dedicated deployments, and be low-friction in the UI for fast incident response.
acceptance_criteria: Console has a new 'Contrast Workbench' view reachable from deployment detail pages
Users can select two or three variants and see aligned per-route time-series (latency, error, token-cost) with delta overlays and confidence intervals
Request-pairing is available for mirrored traffic: click a delta point and open a side-by-side trace comparison (input, model outputs, model meta, token counts)
A policy editor supports at least three auto-fallback strategies (absolute threshold, percentage delta, and anomaly-score-based) with visual simulation before enabling
Auto-fallback can be toggled per-route and executes a safe fallback (route-level switch to control variant) with an audit log entry and optional Slack/Webhook notification
Back-end ingestion includes joined telemetry for paired-mirrored requests and computes per-route aggregated deltas at 1m and 5m granularity
Feature works end-to-end for both hosted API customers and Dedicated pools in the staging environment
Documentation and an SRE runbook for operations, including a post-rollback checklist, are published
tasks: Product: finalize UI information architecture and define delta metrics + priority list
Design: create Workbench mocks (desktop and narrow console panels) and an in-UI policy editor prototype
Engineering (Backend): add joined telemetry tables for mirrored request-pairs and delta computations
Engineering (Frontend): implement Workbench layout, delta overlays, histogram diff widgets, and trace side-by-side viewer
Engineering (Core): expose per-route toggle and safe-switch API for automatic fallback with audit trail
SRE: author rollout playbook and test auto-fallback in staging with simulated regressions
QA: create e2e tests that validate paired trace comparisons and policy triggers
Docs: write Console docs, admin guide, and runbook for product+SRE teams
notes: Trade-offs: full-fidelity trace storage is expensive; initial rollout will limit paired-request retention to 7 days and sample by route/traffic share
We must avoid automatic model weight switches without explicit route-level opt-in and guardrails
Consider adding a read-only observer role in Console for SRE and auditors to view comparisons without control permissions

decisions: Initial rollout will support up to 3-way comparisons (control/variant/mirror) rather than unlimited variants to keep UI and compute complexity bounded
Auto-fallback actions will be route-scoped and implement a guarded switch API that requires a confirmation with estimated impact before execution
Paired-request comparison will show only sanitized inputs/outputs by default to respect PII policies; full payload access requires additional audit justification
